title: Minimax Rates for the CATE Distribution Function at a Saddle Level
banked_reason: The note proves a genuine logarithmic minimax and honesty bracket, but not the proposed sharp frontier; the unresolved logarithmic gap and finite-dimensional fixed-law bootstrap cap it at subfield below the field floor.
gap_reasons: The note proves a non-obvious n^-3/8 lower bound for classes containing its localized pair and a class-uniform, honest upper bound of order (log n/n)^3/8; this is a genuine logarithmic bracket, not a sharp minimax rate.

The phase law requires a smooth learner tangent, while the refitted bootstrap is proved only in the correctly specified finite-dimensional exact-saddle model, so neither supplies uniform near-critical distributional inference.
The unresolved rate and narrow bootstrap scope limit the projected leading-journal score despite the valid bracket and honest interval.
proof_attempt_summary: The run attempted a sharp n^-3/8 minimax and honest-inference frontier for sorted-CATE quantiles near two-dimensional Morse saddles. It proved matching lower experiments, a finite-grid honest upper construction with a logarithmic loss, a counterexample to the natural continuum plug-in, and a fixed-law finite-dimensional phase/bootstrap theory; the claim of sharp attainment collapsed because the logarithm remains unresolved. A future re-raise must close that rate gap or obtain genuinely uniform near-critical distributional inference rather than replaying the existing bracket.
tldr: For the canonical square median class and any admissible near-critical class containing the stipulated localized pair, absolute-risk and honest expected-diameter lower bounds are \(n^{-3/8}\), and the squared-risk lower bound is \(n^{-3/4}\). For every fixed admissible near-critical class, a finite-grid stabilized fit and held-out inverse attain class-uniform absolute risk and honest diameter \(O((\log n/n)^{3/8})\), squared risk \(O((\log n/n)^{3/4})\), and calibrated coverage. These form logarithmic brackets. The original continuum plug-in fails on a near-flat-passage sequence. Separate exact-saddle results give a smooth-tangent phase law, fold-overlap covariance, and a finite-dimensional shared-weight refitted bootstrap.
gap: Sorted-effects limit and bootstrap theory excludes critical values, while recent CATE-sublevel work leaves its CDF minimax rate open. The inverse quantile at a learned saddle, especially uniform risk and honesty across detaching nearby laws, is not settled by either result.
fill: Establish matching \(n^{-3/8}\) risk and honest-confidence diameter under stated global design and geometric constants; separately establish the exact-base weighted smooth-tangent limit, fold covariance, and a fully refitted bootstrap for a correctly specified finite-dimensional learner.
